title: Create Spanish presentation website for BlueFire cybersecurity company

requirements.text: Create a hero section with the company name 'BlueFire' prominently displayed, a tagline emphasizing cybersecurity consulting expertise in Mexico, and a primary call-to-action button for contacting or requesting a pilot scan. Include a visually striking hero background image.

quotes: give me a website for presentation of a cybersecurity company in spanish called bluefire

acceptanceCriteria: Hero section displays 'BlueFire' as the company name
Tagline conveys cybersecurity consulting focus for Mexican market
CTA button is prominent and actionable
Hero background image is rendered from generated assets

requirements.text: Create a Services section in Spanish explaining the four core services: Registro de Activos (Asset Registry), Evaluación de Vulnerabilidades (Vulnerability Assessment), Remediación de Vulnerabilidades, and Segmentación de Redes (Network Segmentation). Each service must include a description, why it's necessary in the Mexican context, and key benefits as detailed in the source document.
acceptanceCriteria: Four services are displayed with Spanish titles and descriptions
Each service includes purpose, necessity in Mexican market, and benefits
Content matches the detailed descriptions from the source document
Services are presented in a visually organized grid or card layout

requirements.text: Create a Market Context section in Spanish highlighting cybersecurity statistics for Mexico: over 40 billion cyberattack attempts in H1 2025, 35,200 million in Q1 2026, 74% of Mexican companies affected by ransomware in 2025, sectors most affected (finance 31%, health 21%, manufacturing 19%), and PYME vulnerability statistics (only 40% have active security protocols despite representing 99.8% of Mexican businesses).

quotes: México enfrentó más de 40 mil millones de intentos de ciberataques en el primer semestre de 2025
el 74% de las empresas mexicanas fueron afectadas por ransomware ese año
solo cerca del 40% tienen protocolos de seguridad activos

acceptanceCriteria: Statistics section displays key threat data for Mexico
Attack volume numbers are prominently displayed (40B+, 35.2B)
Sector breakdown shows finance, health, and manufacturing percentages
PYME vulnerability statistics are highlighted
All content is in Spanish

requirements.text: Create a Target Clients section in Spanish differentiating service approach for PYMEs (short sales cycle, standardized services, accessible pricing, simplified deliverables) versus Maquiladoras (long sales cycle, formal SOW and NDA required, professional insurance needed, higher-ticket projects, recurring contracts). acceptanceCriteria: Two distinct client segments are clearly differentiated
PYME characteristics are listed (short cycle, standardized, accessible)
Maquiladora characteristics are listed (long cycle, formal contracts, insurance)

requirements.text: Create a Workflow Overview section in Spanish explaining the MAIVOR workflow process for Asset Registry, Vulnerability Assessment, Patching, and Network Segmentation. Emphasize the secure, repeatable methodology for IT/OT environments.

quotes: MAIVOR Workflow: Asset, VA, Patching, Segmentation
workflow operativo de MAIVOR para ejecutar los servicios de Asset Registry, Vulnerability Assessment, Parcheo de vulnerabilidades y Segmentación de red

acceptanceCriteria: Workflow section explains the four main service processes
